svg.title: Measurement filtering on the heater
svg.desc: Without the filter the heater command wanders by 0.12 percentage point around 90 percent; a 1 second filter reduces this to ±0.04 point and a 2 second filter to 0.02 point, but with 2 seconds the water overshoots to 38.30 degrees Celsius.
svg.text: Control Studio validation runs of this project · 3 °C setpoint step · set B, β = 0.8 · numbers answer the predictions
No filter: ±0.12 point; Tf = 1 s: ±0.04 point; Tf = 2 s: ±0.02 point
